name: template-gallery
purpose: The templates band of a solution page: a framed media split whose copy side invites the reader to start from a template and whose media side is a scrolling two-column wall of deployable template cards, closed by a ticker of the frameworks and clouds it works with. Each card is a mark, a title, one line and a deploy action. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'template-gallery', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — so its whole API is the props below, and it composes `section-module`, `media-split`, `scroll-area`, `card-grid`, `button`, `frame-box` and `ticker` rather than owning any anatomy of its own.
useWhen: On a solution page (Retail, Web Apps, AI Workloads, Security, Performance, Streaming) to show the templates a reader can deploy right away.
Whenever a band pairs one pitch with a long, browsable list of deployable starters.
avoidWhen: For a grid of features with artwork → use `feature-tiles`.
For a ticker of marks alone → compose `ticker` directly.
For a handful of icon-led use cases → use `use-cases`.
related: media-split` — the framed copy-and-media split the band is built on; it owns the band's named region.
ticker` — the row of framework and cloud marks that closes the band.
bestPractices: Keep the wall to an even number of templates so the two columns end level.
Turn on `invertInDark` only for a mark whose artwork ships in dark ink, so it stays legible on the dark theme.
Set `templatesAriaLabel` so the scrolling wall is announced by name.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the media split as its `h2` and naming its region.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: First button under the copy, drawn as the large secondary button; `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }`. Omitted when absent.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.doc: Second button under the copy, drawn as the large outlined button; `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }`. Omitted when absent.

props.name: templates
props.doc: The template cards of the scrolling wall, in order; each is `{ title, description?, icon?, invertInDark?, href? }`. Templates without a title are skipped.

props.name: deployLabel
props.doc: Label of the deploy button on each card; a card renders its button only when both this and its `href` are set.

props.name: templatesAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the scrolling wall of templates.

props.name: tickerLabel
props.doc: Overline above the row of marks.

props.name: tickerMarks
props.doc: Registry names of the frameworks and clouds in the row of marks, in order; the ticker is omitted when empty.
